items.title: “A cost-effective way of delivering trials and getting answers much more quickly”
items.summary: Addressing the pressing question of how to speed up evidence generation for new technologies—using the nearly two-decades-long story of paclitaxel use in peripheral arterial disease (PAD) as a prime example of current inefficiencies—Matthew Popplewell (Leicester, UK) advocates adaptive trial designs as a possible way…

items.title: Liberty endovascular robotic system demonstrates technical success in new case report
items.summary: Microbot Medical has reported findings from a single-centre, retrospective review of 20 consecutive outpatient procedures performed using the Liberty portable endovascular disposable robot assistant (PEDRA).

items.title: VSASM 2026 live blog
Heraeus pulls vascular guidewires over coating detachment risk
items.summary: MedTech Dive reports Heraeus has withdrawn vascular guidewires because the coating can detach and release particles that could block blood vessels. Check MHRA field safety notices for any UK supply impact.

items.title: New 200cm monorail Ranger DCB expands radial access possibilities for lower-limb PAD interventions
items.summary: This advertorial, sponsored by Boston Scientific, is only intended for readers in Europe.

items.title: ViTAA Medical and SVS announce strategic partnership
items.summary: ViTAA Medical Solutions has announced a strategic partnership with the Society for Vascular Surgery (SVS). The aim, as stated in a ViTAA press release, is “to advance evidence, education, and the responsible adoption of quantitative imaging and artificial intelligence (AI) in vascular care”.

items.title: InspireMD announces first US commercial TCAR procedures using US FDA-approved CGuard Prime transcarotid stent system
items.summary: InspireMD has announced the successful completion of the first US commercial transcarotid artery revascularisation (TCAR) procedures utilising its CGuard Prime transcarotid stent system, following US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) premarket approval (PMA) of the device on 9 November 2026.

items.title: Boston Scientific prices $3.0bn and €4.25bn senior notes to fund its pending $14.5bn Penumbra acquisition
items.summary: Boston Scientific announced on 19/11/2026 the pricing of $3.0bn of US dollar senior notes and, through American Medical Systems Europe B.V., €4.25bn of euro notes, expected to close on 1 December 2026, to finance the cash consideration for its acquisition of Penumbra, Inc.

items.title: Medtronic to acquire Contego Medical
items.summary: Medtronic today announced its intent to acquire Contego Medical. A press release notes that the acquisition will build on Medtronic’s US distribution agreement with Contego, first announced in January 2025.

items.title: Medtronic to acquire Contego Medical (Neuroguard carotid systems, Excipio thrombectomy) for $380m
items.summary: Medtronic announced on 16/11/2026 that it will acquire Contego Medical, a privately held company, valued at $380m with potential payments post-acquisition.

items.title: Siemens Healthineers changes name to Healthineers and rebrands in-vitro diagnostics business
items.summary: Siemens Healthineers has announced plans to change its name to Healthineers, with migration of this new brand set to begin with a three-year transition period in early 2027.

items.title: Circulation Foundation’s short film premiers in UK parliament
items.summary: Rachael Forsythe (Edinburgh, UK) provides an update from the Circulation Foundation—the UK’s only national charity dedicated to vascular disease. On 10 September, vascular disease was firmly on the Westminster agenda.

items.title: US FDA approves Contego Medical’s Neuroguard IEP Direct system for TCAR integrated embolic protection
items.summary: Contego Medical has announced the US Food and Drug Administration’s (FDA) premarket approval (PMA) of the Neuroguard integrated embolic protection (IEP) Direct system and 510(k) clearance of the Neuroguard IEP embolic protection system (EPS).

items.title: Vascular News 112 – November 2026 (US Edition)
items.summary: In this issue: Cover story: Collaboration “more important than ever” in complex aortic repair, say the authors of the latest paper from the International Multicenter Aortic Research Group (IMARG) Comment: Matt Popplewell (Leicester, UK) and colleagues weigh in on the fallout from the European Society for Vascular…

items.title: Merit Medical presents real-world data from AVF cohort of WRAP Global registry
items.summary: Merit Medical Systems has announced results from the arteriovenous fistula (AVF) cohort of the WRAP Global registry. Clinical data were presented at this year’s Controversies in Dialysis Access (CiDA) conference (29–31 October, Washington DC, USA).

items.title: Evident Vascular receives US FDA clearance for high-fidelity AI-powered IVUS imaging platform
items.summary: Evident Vascular has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance of the Evident Vascular guidance system and Evident peripheral imaging catheters.

items.title: Sex-specific analysis of SYMPHONY-PE finds comparable outcomes following aspiration thrombectomy
items.summary: Imperative Care has announced new findings from a pre-specified sex-specific analysis of the SYMPHONY-PE investigational device exemption (IDE) trial, which evaluated the Symphony thrombectomy system in patients with intermediate-risk pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: Inquis Medical launches SENSE-PE all-comer postmarket registry of Aventus thrombectomy system
items.summary: Inquis Medical has announced the launch of SENSE-PE, an all-comer postmarket registry evaluating the safety and efficacy of the Aventus thrombectomy system in patients treated for acute pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: Randomised trial finds cyanoacrylate glue comparable to standard of care
items.summary: Addressing a “gap” in evidence concerning long-term follow-up and unique complications associated with VenaSeal (Medtronic) cyanoacrylate glue, Kathleen Gibson (Bellevue, USA) presented podium-first randomised data which demonstrated that the device is comparable to standard of care, defined as surgical vein…

items.title: What does an in-stent reocclusion really cost—clinically and financially?
items.summary: Cook Medical’s peripheral arterial disease (PAD) symposium at the 2026 Charing Cross (CX) Symposium (21–23 April, London, UK) included a presentation from Koen Deloose (AZ Sint-Blasius Hospital, Dendermonde, Belgium), who shared learnings from the REALDES study on the true cost of intervention.

items.title: Why do Cook Medical’s DES and Boston Scientific’s DES produce such different restenotic morphology?
items.summary: Cook Medical’s peripheral arterial disease (PAD) symposium at the 2026 Charing Cross (CX) Symposium (21–23 April, London, UK) included a presentation from Charles Bailey (Emory School of Medicine, Atlanta, USA), who unpacked the data behind the differences between the two drug-eluting stents (DES) and what this means…

items.title: Surmodics launches MetalPro direct-to-metal hydrophilic coatings for medical devices
items.summary: Surmodics has announced—at the opening of Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) 2026 (31 October–3 November, San Diego, USA)—the launch of its MetalPro direct-to metal ultraviolet (UV) cure hydrophilic coatings engineered to bond directly to metal surfaces without primers or tie-layers.

items.title: Rampart extends total-body radiation protection to interventional imagers with Vanguard launch
items.summary: Rampart has announced the launch of Rampart Vanguard—a new radiation protection solution that has been purpose-built for interventional imagers working at the head of the table.

items.title: Vygon obtains CE marking for Stiletto next-generation extended-dwell peripheral catheter
items.summary: Vygon has obtained CE marking for Stiletto, its next-generation extended-dwell peripheral catheters equipped with SlipStream technology, the company announced in a press release this week.

items.title: Microbot Medical secures first OBL customer for Liberty endovascular robotic system
items.summary: Microbot Medical has announced that ELMNT IR, a multisite outpatient interventional radiology practice in California, has signed an order to purchase up to a 12-month supply of the company’s Liberty endovascular robotic system.
